dimensions.name: Correctness
dimensions.description: This dimension evaluates whether the algorithm's logic accurately computes the delivery fee for all valid input combinations, adhering to standard fee calculation rules.
sub_criteria: The logic correctly calculates the initial fee based on a base amount and distance-based increment.
The logic correctly applies a small order surcharge when the order total falls below a specified threshold.
The logic correctly sets the delivery fee to zero if the order total meets or exceeds a free delivery threshold.
The logic correctly caps the final calculated delivery fee at a maximum allowed amount.

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.description: This dimension assesses if all necessary components for a comprehensive delivery fee calculation, including input handling, conditional logic, and output, are present in the pseudocode.
sub_criteria: The pseudocode includes steps to accept both the order total and delivery distance as inputs.
The pseudocode includes conditional logic to evaluate different fee scenarios, such as small order surcharges and free delivery thresholds.
The pseudocode includes a step to provide the final calculated delivery fee as an output.
The pseudocode addresses edge cases where delivery distance or order total might be zero or negative, ensuring a sensible calculation.

dimensions.name: Clarity
dimensions.description: This dimension evaluates how easily a human can understand the logical flow and the purpose of each step in the delivery fee calculation.
sub_criteria: Variable and constant names clearly indicate their purpose within the fee calculation (e.g., 'orderTotal', 'deliveryDistance', 'baseFee').
Each step of the fee calculation is described in clear, straightforward language, making its intention easy to grasp.
The overall sequence of operations logically progresses from inputs through calculations to the final fee, making the flow simple to follow.

dimensions.name: Efficiency
dimensions.description: This dimension evaluates whether the pseudocode avoids redundant calculations or unnecessary processing steps in determining the delivery fee.
sub_criteria: The pseudocode avoids recalculating intermediate fee components that have already been determined.
The pseudocode applies the different fee rules in a logical sequence, preventing unnecessary re-evaluation or modification of the fee.
